slides.texte_overlay:
Man to man, here's how
you come back from
a rough year

1. Drop one bad habit
Just one. The worst one.
You don't need a new life,
you need one less leak.

2. Call one old friend
The one you lost touch with.
He probably had
a rough year too.

3. Move every day
A walk counts.
Motion first, motivation later.

4. Fill the empty hours
Replace one scroll a day
with one new idea.
Your mind needs fuel.
slides.texte_sophia:
4. Fill the empty hours
Replace one scroll a day
with one lesson on the Sophia app.
Your mind needs fuel.

slides.texte_overlay:
5. Set one 90-day goal
Write it down.
Put it where you'll see it
every morning.

6. Get outside before noon
Fresh air, daylight, a walk.
The day feels different
when you start it outside.
